title: Bridge weak and strong AI usage patterns
measurement_note: Timing is estimated from command/log milestones after web-first intake began.

phases.label: Web-first intake
phases.bottleneck_notes: Checked AI power user, AI literacy, task-fit, adoption, appropriate reliance, risk, and mental model sources.

phases.label: Existing structure review
phases.bottleneck_notes: Reviewed memory bootstrap, operations index, prompt router, persistent instructions, requirements baseline, and operating model placement.

phases.label: Profile and workflow implementation
phases.bottleneck_notes: Added usage profile, operating model, workflow, prompt, router/index/persistent instruction updates, memory anchor, and requirements/spec artifacts.

phases.label: Documentation and history
phases.bottleneck_notes: Writing web search records, research notes, request traces, work summaries, and evaluation files.

phases.label: Verification
phases.bottleneck_notes: Ran config, memory, docs, naming, structure, map, task-board, workspace-health, grounding, evaluator, and timing checks.

phases.label: Commit and push
phases.bottleneck_notes: Committed coherent change set and prepared immediate push.

bottleneck_analysis.interpretation: The main cost is cross-cutting governance integration across configs, docs, memory bootstrap, prompts, workflows, requirements, specs, and history.
improvement_candidates: If AI-use coaching repeats often, add a deterministic diagnosis helper that emits gap classification and bridge intervention suggestions.
Use this profile during future vague user requests before creating new tools or workflows.
